name: Lezzoo
description: Lezzoo is an on-demand delivery Superapp for Iraq.

founders.name: Rekar Botany
founders.bio: CTO and Co-founder of Lezzoo Inc., Iraq’s leading Super App. As a computer engineer and entrepreneur, I’m passionate about building scalable technology solutions that drive real-world impact. At Lezzoo, I focus on AI integration, workflow automation, and product development, ensuring that our platform evolves to meet market demands. I specialize in Node.js and React Native, and I’ve developed internal automation tools, AI-driven bots, and Chrome extensions to optimize our operations.

founders.name: Yadgar Merani
founders.bio: I'm a Kurdish Iraqi, born in London and moved to Iraq at age 3. My journey in the startup world began in Iraq, where we founded a startup that was the first in the country to receive backing from Y Combinator. Passionate about innovation and startups, I'm dedicated to making a positive impact through my work!
